an5.40:1.1: XL. Himavantaṃ bhikkhave pabbatarājaṃ nissāya mahāsālā pañcahi vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhanti. Katamāhi pañcahi? Sākhāpattapalāsena vaḍḍhanti, tacena vaḍḍhanti, papaṭikāya vaḍḍanti, pheggunā vaḍḍhanti, sārena vaḍḍhanti. Himavantaṃ bhikkhave pabbatarājaṃ nissāya mahāsālā imāhi pañcahi vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhanti. Evam eva kho bhikkhave saddhaṃ kulapatiṃ nissāya antojano pañcahi vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhati. Katamāhi pañcahi? Saddhāya vaḍḍhati, sīlena vaḍḍhati, sutena vaḍḍhati, cāgena vaḍḍhati, paññāya vaḍḍhati. Saddhaṃ bhikkhave kulapatiṃ nissāya antojano imāhi pañcahi vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhatī ti.
an5.40:2.1: Yathā hi pabbato selo araññasmiṃ brahāvane taṃ rukkhā upanissāya vaḍḍhante te vanappatī,
an5.40:3.1: tath'eva sīlasampannaṃ saddhaṃ kulapatim idha upanissāya vaḍḍhanti puttadārā ca bandhavā amaccā ñātisaṅghā ca ye c'assa anujīvino,
an5.40:4.1: tyāssa sīlavato sīlaṃ cāgaṃ sucaritāni ca passamānānukubbanti ye bhavanti vicakkhaṇā;
an5.40:5.1: idha dhammaṇ caritvāna maggaṃ sugatigāminaṃ nandino devalokasmiṃ modanti kāmakāmino ti. Sumanavaggo catuttho.
an5.40:6.0: Udānaṃ: Sumanā Cundi Uggaho Sīho dānānisaṃsayo Kālabhojanasaddhā ca ṭhānaputtena
